_comment: Review is required only when BOTH thresholds are met (AND). A 1-file / 1-line default would demand a receipt for every typo, so the numbers sit where self-review stops being enough: 2 files AND 30 changed lines. Below that, a single-file fixup or a doc-count correction is checkable by its author; at or above it, the diff is wide enough that a second reader finds things the author cannot. Both numbers are claims about review value, not about effort - keep them honest instead of lowering them to make a gate green. See tools/review_receipt.py.
